_readme: Starter structured scheme dataset for Track B (Scheme Eligibility & Cost-Matching). See Section 6.3 of the AI Training System document for schema. VERIFY AND EXPAND every entry against the official source before real use -- these entries are illustrative starting points based on the project's research summary, not a substitute for checking current official scheme documentation. Update 'last_verified_date' every time an entry is checked.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.eligibility_criteria: Families identified as economically vulnerable under the SECC database, covering approximately the bottom 40% of India's population by income.
schemes.coverage_scope: Secondary and tertiary care hospitalization at empaneled public and private hospitals, cashless treatment.
schemes.last_verified_date: PLACEHOLDER - verify against pib.gov.in or myscheme.gov.in before use
schemes.source_reference: myscheme.gov.in/schemes/ab-pmjay (verify current details before relying on this entry)

schemes.eligibility_criteria: Senior citizens aged 70 years and above, regardless of income.
schemes.coverage_amount: Additional cover under the PM-JAY umbrella for eligible seniors
schemes.coverage_scope: Same hospitalization coverage as general PM-JAY, extended to elderly beneficiaries
schemes.source_reference: PIB press release on PM-JAY senior citizen expansion (verify current details before relying on this entry)

schemes.eligibility_criteria: Available to all citizens, no income restriction, at any PMBJP outlet (Jan Aushadhi Kendra).
schemes.coverage_amount: Not a cash cover -- generic medicines priced 60-80% lower than market rate
schemes.coverage_scope: Retail purchase of generic medicines at subsidized prices; approximately 18,000+ outlets nationally.
schemes.source_reference: PIB press release on PMBJP (verify current outlet count and pricing before relying on this entry)

schemes.scheme_name: Affordable Medicines and Reliable Implants for Treatment (AMRIT)
schemes.eligibility_criteria: Available to all citizens, no income restriction.
schemes.coverage_amount: Not a cash cover -- branded drugs and implants at approximately half of commercial market cost
schemes.coverage_scope: Retail purchase of branded medicines/implants at AMRIT pharmacy outlets, typically co-located with major public hospitals.
schemes.source_reference: Project research summary citing AMRIT pricing structure (verify current outlet locations before relying on this entry)

schemes.eligibility_criteria: PM-JAY eligible beneficiaries requiring cataract surgery.
schemes.coverage_amount: Package-rate cashless coverage under PM-JAY at empaneled hospitals
schemes.coverage_scope: Ophthalmic surgical package -- cataract removal and lens implantation
schemes.last_verified_date: PLACEHOLDER - verify exact package rate against current PM-JAY Health Benefit Packages (HBP) list before use
schemes.source_reference: PM-JAY Health Benefit Packages master list (verify before relying on this entry)

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Arogya Mandir (formerly Health & Wellness Centres)
schemes.eligibility_criteria: Available to all citizens at the local level, no separate enrollment needed beyond visiting the centre.
schemes.coverage_amount: Free comprehensive primary care -- not hospitalization cover
schemes.coverage_scope: Free outpatient consultation, basic diagnostics, and essential medicines at the primary-care level (upgraded Sub-Centres/PHCs).
schemes.source_reference: PIB press release on PM-ABHIM / Ayushman Arogya Mandir rollout (verify before relying on this entry)
